name: CoQ10
effects: Mitochondrial electron transport chain component — ATP synthesis
Ubiquinol (reduced form) has superior bioavailability, especially in older adults
Statin-induced CoQ10 depletion hypothesis — evidence for supplementation mixed
Investigated for heart failure, migraine prevention, and male fertility
Take with fat-containing meal — highly lipophilic
Very safe; mild GI symptoms occasionally reported
halfLifeNotes: Terminal t½ 33.19 ± 5.32 h after a single 100 mg oral dose of deuterium-labeled d5-CoQ10 in 16 healthy males; the stable label is what separates exogenous dose from the large endogenous pool, and unlabeled-supplement estimates range ~22-92 h depending on formulation and baseline handling.
